summary: I built the core of a SaaS crypto algo trading platform (summit), adding follow management, strategy catalog, and email authentication. Simultaneously, I developed firmware for USB HID devices (j-uni-hid) and a Windows input filter driver (input-driver). On the research side, I continuously refined a crypto price prediction model (crypto-model-research), running audits and discarding hypotheses. I also worked on multiple secondary projects: an Android TTS engine (j-tts-android), an on-device LLM with phone automation (ozwil-android), a file-tagging utility for Windows Explorer (intag2), and an agentic worker framework (agent-harness). Additionally, I built a poker computer vision pipeline (poker-cv), a trading strategy repository (freqtrade_startegies), and maintained Telegram bot infrastructure (freqtrade-tg-multibot). The year also saw the start of a minimal AutoHotKey alternative (jolt) and a graph-powered code intelligence engine (jaxon). Across these projects, I worked on full-stack features, firmware, driver development, machine learning research, and infrastructure.

items.title: SaaS crypto algo trading platform
items.description: Built follow management features including interactive exit simulator, open position tracking, and costs. Reworked strategy catalog with exchange suitability filters and per-follow history. Added email authentication and admin backfill.

items.title: Crypto price prediction model research
items.description: Conducted a full audit of the model pipeline, discarding several hypotheses (HMM state features, isotonic sizing) and keeping Mondrian conformal gates. Prepared refit runbooks and drift monitoring tooling.

items.title: Windows Explorer file-tagging utility
items.description: Fixed settings persistence, Explorer refresh, and backdrop fallback. Added Vorbis comment writing for audio files.

items.title: Agentic worker framework
items.description: Built workspace-aware Telegram threading, memory management with hybrid retrieval, and a graphical control room. Added tenant interaction channels and resource registration.

items.title: File-tagging utility maintenance
items.description: Collapsed the two-stage release into a single workflow, fixed metadata write failures, and added Vorbis comment support for ogg files.

items.title: Crypto trading strategy development
items.description: Added pack-relative reversion and BTC-relative reversion strategies, with forward testing and documentation.

items.title: Personal CV automation
items.description: Enhanced the CV generation pipeline with LLM-based timeline, improved heatmap and project cards, and added dry-run mode.

items.title: Trading strategy iteration
items.description: Developed multiple EwoDip and reversion strategies, documented forward test results, and tuned parameters.

items.title: Minimal AutoHotKey alternative
items.description: Built the scenario engine with typed actions, input gates, and Interception support. Added conditions, rules, and sound actions.

items.title: USB HID firmware for ESP32-S3
items.description: Added fire-and-forget emitting and an 8x8 matrix variant. Introduced platformio support.

items.title: Windows input filter driver
items.description: Built a KMDF driver for keyboard and mouse capture and injection. Added event filtering, hardware ID matching, and integration tests.

items.title: Android TTS engine with multiple models
items.description: Integrated VITS, Piper, and F5-TTS engines. Added pitch control, text normalisation with RuNorm, and background TTS with core pinning.

items.title: File-tagging utility updates
items.description: Fixed desktop.ini encoding for non-ASCII characters and added PDF support to the context menu.

items.title: Computer vision assist tool
items.description: Switched YOLO inference to DirectML, added bow/flick feature with tracking, and improved the debug overlay.

items.title: USB HID firmware iteration
items.description: Drafted a new firmware variant and fixed USB disconnection issues.

items.title: File-tagging utility fixes
items.description: Fixed changelog generation and preserved existing desktop.ini entries when writing folder metadata.

items.title: E-reader firmware with maps and knowledge base
items.description: Added Knowledge Base and Map applications, optimised the map renderer, and improved FB2 encoding support.

items.title: Computer vision assist updates
items.description: Added HP aim scaling, YOLO confidence threshold UI, and runtime fallback to USB-HID.

items.title: USB HID firmware advancement
items.description: Introduced dual-core and USB variants of the firmware.

items.title: On-device LLM with phone automation
items.description: Rewrote the sub-agent architecture with session-based delegation and tool calling. Added background service, wake processing, and model presets.

items.title: E-reader firmware enhancements
items.description: Rewritten the Map app UI for landscape, added PDF/DjVu conversion, and fixed encoding issues.

items.title: Computer vision assist improvements
items.description: Rewrote the overlay to D3D11, added linger and autofire modes, and persisted state across restarts.

items.title: Pet research on poker computer vision
items.description: Developed a pipeline for card detection, hand reconstruction, and log validation from video. Achieved high accuracy for hero cards and board cards.

items.title: Graph-powered code intelligence engine
items.description: Added language support for C++, Go, Rust, and Svelte. Implemented dead code detection, LSP integration, and incremental sync.

items.title: Neovim dotfiles

items.title: Telegram bot for multi-bot management
items.description: Built a web application with Docker support, improved Telegram authentication, and refined profit calculations.
